controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HD 5278; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of HD 5278 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of hd-5278's light, as its colour dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HD 5278's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 5278 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

HD 5278 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (93, 94, 95) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 263003176, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 11 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 19-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.

physical.credit: Radius from Sozzetti et al. 2021 (2021A&A...648A..75S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Sozzetti et al. 2021, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2021A&A...648A..75S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Sozzetti et al. 2021 (2021A&A...648A..75S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
